question: Which goddesses are invoked to dwell in the spine and on the sides?
premises: Ambikā is asked to dwell in the spine.
Medinī is asked to dwell on the sides.
Both are protective placements in the body.
inference: Ambikā is invoked in the spine and Medinī on the sides.
plain_english: May Ambikā dwell in the spine, and may Medinī dwell on the sides.
